name: Acceptance suite-3 test 87 - partial wildcard in a Federated principal is invalid (fail closed)
note: IAM-1006 (Phase 10, iteration 4) adversarial finding: partial-wildcard fail-closed was scoped to the AWS Principal key only, so a never-matching Federated member (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/*) was presented as a complete federated trust with coverage.incomplete=false. A Federated principal is a SPECIFIC identity-provider ARN (an IAM OIDC/SAML provider) or built-in OIDC hostname; the element does not wildcard-match provider ARNs, so the globbed member matches no provider and must fail closed exactly like a wildcard AWS Principal ARN. It is located at Principal.Federated[0], produces no TRUST-FEDERATED trust, and marks coverage incomplete with INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN.
